description: This file is a C source file configuring and implementing RTE (Runtime Environment) functions for an AUTOSAR-based embedded system, including initialization, pre- and post- routines for various runnables, and a main task loop.

methods.name: Rte_PRE_TesterRunnable
methods.description: Pre-processing routine for TesterRunnable, reads signals and updates internal buffers.

methods.name: Rte_PRE_FreqReqRunnable
methods.description: Pre-processing routine for FreqReqRunnable, reads frequency request signal.

methods.name: Rte_PRE_LoggerRunnable
methods.description: Pre-processing routine for LoggerRunnable, updates logger result buffer.

methods.name: Rte_PRE_Logger2Runnable
methods.description: Pre-processing routine for Logger2Runnable, updates logger2 result buffer.

methods.name: Rte_POST_TesterRunnable
methods.description: Post-processing routine for TesterRunnable, sends result signals and writes buffer.

methods.name: Rte_POST_FreqReqRunnable
methods.description: Post-processing routine for FreqReqRunnable, sends frequency indication signal.

methods.name: Rte_TesterRunnable
methods.description: Main function executing pre, main, and post routines for TesterRunnable.

methods.name: Rte_FreqReqRunnable
methods.description: Main function executing pre, main, and post routines for FreqReqRunnable.

methods.name: Rte_Multiply
methods.description: Wrapper for Multiply function, used in RTE context.

methods.name: Rte_LoggerRunnable
methods.description: Wrapper to execute LoggerRunnable with pre and main routines.

methods.name: Rte_Logger2Runnable
methods.description: Wrapper to execute Logger2Runnable with pre and main routines.

methods.name: Rte_Start
methods.description: Initialization function for RTE, returns success status.

methods.name: StepTask
methods.description: Main task loop handling events and executing corresponding RTE functions.
